title: Board Policy, Local: One School Nutrition Services Meal Account per Student
content:
**1.** Each student has one School Nutrition Services Meal Account for the whole time the student attends the district, and a household may hold accounts for any number of students; the district sets no limit on the number of accounts per household, and the number of accounts per student is 1.

**2.** A meal account is opened only for a student who has no meal account in status active or inactive. The test is made on the district's meal account records for that same student before the account is opened; what a caller says about an earlier account does not replace that record.

**3.** A student who re-enrolls keeps the existing account, which is reactivated rather than opened again; a closed account is never reopened and a re-entering student whose account was closed receives a new account.

## Opening test, by the status of the student's existing account

| The student's existing meal account | A new account may be opened |
|---|---|
| none | yes |
| active | no |
| inactive | no (the existing account is reactivated on re-enrollment) |
| closed only | yes, a new account |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A household with three children holds three accounts, one per child. When one child withdraws and returns the following spring, that child's inactive account comes back into use with its balance; had the account been closed in the meantime, the child would receive a new account.
